headline: Aurobindo Pharma completes acquisition of US-listed generic pharmaceuticals company Lannett
sum: Aurobindo Pharma USA Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma Limited, completed its acquisition of Lannett Company Inc. on 30 June 2026, marking the Indian pharma firm's landmark consolidation in the US generic drugs market.
detail: Aurobindo Pharma Limited, a major Indian generic pharmaceutical manufacturer, completed the acquisition of Lannett Company Inc., a US-listed producer of generic and branded pharmaceuticals, through its wholly owned US subsidiary Aurobindo Pharma USA Inc. The completion intimation was filed with the NSE on 30 June 2026. This deal represents a significant cross-border consolidation in the generic pharmaceuticals sector, expanding Aurobindo's US market footprint. The acquisition structure-use of a wholly owned subsidiary as the acquisition vehicle-is standard for foreign investor protection under US securities law and Indian FEMA compliance.
